196012: When modern schoolgirl Nanoka finds herself transported to Taisho-era Japan, a world rich with supernatural beings, she crosses paths with Mao, an ancient and cursed mystic. As their individual mysteries and pasts connect, they become entangled in unraveling dark powers and complex truths, blending historical fantasy, supernatural action, and compelling intrigue. This series offers an adventure where two individuals from disparate eras must unite to confront a shared destiny.
199066: A former Demon King, now a modern-day shut-in, has his peaceful NEET life shattered when the Hero who once defeated him suddenly reappears as a high school girl. This romantic comedy explores their explosive reunion as these two past adversaries navigate an unexpected new life, often with chaotic and humorous results. It appeals to fans of fantasy reincarnation, unlikely romance, and lighthearted character dynamics.
208225: Elsa, a noblewoman from a fallen house, enters an arranged marriage with the distinguished Julius, only for him to declare his lack of love after the wedding. Despite this cold start, their political union promises a charming journey of awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and gradually growing feelings. This series explores the challenges and joys of two strangers learning to love in an unexpected marriage.
